why: The other half of issue #555, and the half that survives the grid being fixed: with the population correct but the OFFER still keyed on campaign length, a fresh five-level campaign shows a Levels button leading to a pane holding no buttons at all (`unlocked` counts CLEARED levels, so it is 0 before the first win). That is both a choice of one -- which the sandbox case has always refused on identical reasoning -- and a standing hint that there is more, on the first screen a new player sees. Pinned separately from the grid entries because the two are independent: either can be reverted without the other.
killedBy: hud: level select panel offers the Levels button on what is UNLOCKED, not on what the campaign holds
